CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

2. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 40.5

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

8. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

9. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 19
   C. 38
   D. 30

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 15
   C. 22
   D. 30

12. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

13. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 1, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 2, 4, 6

14. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 12.5
   C. 5
   D. 6

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

16. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

17. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

18. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

19. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 40
   C. 75
   D. 20

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 55
   C. 22
   D. 16

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

23. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 11

24. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
